protocol.fit: Use the 56 existing GRID development control files. Select the third-highest ordinary maximum with a floor of 0.04 per arm.
protocol.held: Score all 92 previously held H.264 files, including 17 authored synchronized redrawing cases and 75 ordinary controls.
protocol.prediction: Compute symmetric interpolation between the outer eye-aligned frames at one and two native steps from center. The candidate uses forward and reverse dense flow from only those neighbors and compares their warped midpoint with the observed middle picture. Both hops must support a positive mouth-minus-surround change.
protocol.qualification: Use the exact local picture clock, same observed shot, complete neighboring face geometry, and the existing 8/12/16/20-frame interval selector with five-picture flanks. Require genuine point separation before adopting.
protocol.release: Require at least four strictly aligned LivePortrait locations across three groups and the strictly aligned MuseTalk location, at most two ordinary flags and none on untouched or hard-cut controls. Report support and misses.
